pov_scope: Validate fix stability under timeout margin and support AI-assisted internal ticket triage with similar-ticket lookup.

endpoints.purpose: List active or recently updated tickets for the internal triage queue.

query_parameters.name: since_date
query_parameters.description: Return tickets updated at or after this timestamp.

query_parameters.name: limit
query_parameters.description: Maximum number of tickets to return.

errors.message: since_date must be a valid ISO-8601 date-time; limit must be within allowed bounds.

backing.mongodb_operation: find on tickets with status in active triage statuses and updated_at >= since_date, sorted by updated_at desc, limited.
